name: Outrigger Fiji Beach Resort
positioning: Beachfront resort on 40 acres of tropical gardens on the Coral Coast of Viti Levu, designed to be reminiscent of a traditional Fijian village
best_for: Families wanting pools, a kids club and resort activities
Travelers wanting daily Fijian cultural activities and traditional thatched bures

facts.text: The resort is beachfront on Fiji's Coral Coast, with tropical gardens and coconut groves.
The resort covers 40 acres on the Coral Coast of Viti Levu.
The resort is reminiscent of a traditional Fijian village, with landscaped tropical gardens.
Accommodations range from contemporary rooms with garden and ocean views to traditional Fijian-style thatched plantation and beachfront bures.
Beachfront Bures are traditional Fijian bure bungalows right on the beach.
There is an adults pool with a swim-up pool bar and a lap pool, and a family pool with whirlpool spas and a waterslide.
The Coral Kids Club has dedicated staff to keep children entertained.
The OUTRIGGER Adventure Park offers a golf driving range, rock climbing, axe throwing and paintball.
Complimentary beach activities include kayaking, paddleboarding and snorkeling gear.
Kalo Kalo Bar is a hilltop bar with Pacific Ocean views.
Ivi Restaurant serves Pacific Continental cuisine next to a 100-year-old Ivi tree.
The resort is Green Key certified.

highlights.text: Daily cultural activities include traditional storytelling, meke dance performances, fire walking and village tours.
Guests in Ocean View rooms, suites or bures are offered the Talai Butler Service.
The Plantation Pool Bure has a thatched roof and a private plunge pool.
Guests can join the OUTRIGGER Zone coral planting program, which helps preserve the oceans.

considerations.text: The drive from the resort to the airport takes an hour and 10 minutes.
WhataHotel notes limited dining options near the resort outside the property.
